cases.sentence: Израилетяне вновь стали творить ___ в глазах Господа, и Он на семь лет отдал их в руки мадионитян.
cases.translation: The children of Israel did that which was evil in Yahweh's sight, so Yahweh delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.
cases.explain: The transitive verb творить (to do/commit) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Мадионитяне так угнетали их, что израилетяне стали делать себе укрытие в горной ___.
cases.translation: The Midianites so impoverished Israel that they made themselves dens in the mountains.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Они разбивали у них на земле свои лагеря, губили урожай до самой газы и не оставляли Израилю никакого ___.
cases.translation: They encamped against them and destroyed the increase of the earth, leaving no sustenance for Israel.
cases.explain: The negation не (not) with the accusative becomes genitive in this context to indicate absence of something.

cases.sentence: Они являлись со своим скотом и шатрами, словно рои ___ .
cases.translation: They came with their livestock and their tents as the locusts for multitude.
cases.explain: The collective noun саранча (locusts) in plural takes the genitive after рои (swarms).

cases.sentence: Ангел Господень пришел и сел в офре под ___ который принадлежал Авиазериту.
cases.translation: Yahweh's angel came and sat under the oak in Ophrah which belonged to Joash the Abiezrite.
cases.explain: The preposition под (under) governs the instrumental case when indicating position underneath.

cases.sentence: Его сын Гидеон молотил тогда пшеницу в давильне, чтобы укрыть ее от врага ___.
cases.translation: His son Gideon was beating out wheat in the wine press to hide it from the enemy.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case when indicating protection or separation.

cases.sentence: Когда Ангел Господень явился ему, он сказал, «Господь с тобой, могучий ___».
cases.translation: When Yahweh's angel appeared to him, he said, 'Yahweh is with you, you mighty man of valor!'
cases.explain: Воин is used as a vocative address in apposition, taking the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Гидеон пошел домой, приготовил козленка и сделал из муки пресный ___ .
cases.translation: Gideon went in and prepared a young goat and unleavened cakes of meal.
cases.explain: The transitive verb сделал (made) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

reading.ru: Рука Мидиана преобладала над Израилем, и из-за Мидиана сыны Израилевы делали себе укрытия в горах.
reading.question: How did the Midianites' oppression affect the Israelites?
options: The Israelites made themselves dens and strongholds in the mountains to hide from them
The Israelites defeated the Midianites immediately
reading.correct: The Israelites made themselves dens and strongholds in the mountains to hide from them
reading.explain: The text states that because of Midian's power, the Israelites made themselves dens in the mountains for refuge.

reading.ru: Всякий раз, когда израилетяне сеяли, мадянитяне, амаликитяне и другие восточные народы вторгались в страну.
reading.question: What would happen whenever the Israelites planted crops?
options: The Midianites, Amalekites, and other eastern peoples would invade the country
The Egyptians would come to help
Peace would reign throughout the land
reading.correct: The Midianites, Amalekites, and other eastern peoples would invade the country
reading.explain: The text describes a pattern where every planting season brought invasion from these nations.

reading.ru: Когда израилетяне воззвали Господу из-за мадианитян, он послал им пророка.
reading.question: What did God send to the Israelites when they cried out because of the Midianites?
options: He sent them a prophet to speak His words
He sent them soldiers to fight
He sent them gold and silver
He sent them rain for crops
reading.correct: He sent them a prophet to speak His words
reading.explain: The text states that when Israel cried to Yahweh because of Midian, He sent them a prophet.

reading.ru: «Господь с тобой, могучий воин» — сказал ангел Господень Гидеону.
reading.question: What did the angel say to Gideon?
options: Yahweh is with you, you mighty man of valor
You are too weak to fight
reading.correct: Yahweh is with you, you mighty man of valor
reading.explain: The angel's greeting to Gideon affirms God's presence and recognizes his strength.

reading.ru: Гидеон ответил, «Если я нашел у тебя расположение, то дай мне знак, что это действительно ты говоришь со мной».
reading.question: What did Gideon ask the angel for?
options: He asked for a sign to confirm that the angel was really speaking to him
He asked for money to raise an army
He asked for the angel's name
He asked for permission to leave
reading.correct: He asked for a sign to confirm that the angel was really speaking to him
reading.explain: Gideon requested a sign as proof that he was truly speaking with God's messenger.

reading.ru: Ангел Господень сказал ему, «Возьми мясо и пресный хлеб, положи их на эту скалу и вылей похлебку».
reading.question: What did the angel tell Gideon to do with the food?
options: Put the meat and unleavened bread on the rock and pour out the broth
Burn the meat as an offering
Bury the food in the ground
reading.correct: Put the meat and unleavened bread on the rock and pour out the broth
reading.explain: The angel's instructions led to the miraculous fire that consumed the food as a sign from God.
